name: Chameleon
summary: Dmitri Smerdyakov is the first costumed enemy in The Amazing Spider-Man. He works by impersonation rather than a single superpower. He is a Spider-Man villain from the start of the monthly comic.
relation: Core Spider-Man rogue. The first antagonist of The Amazing Spider-Man.
powers: Master of disguise. Later stories add technological masks. The original tool is impersonation.
origin: A spy and half-brother figure in the Kraven stories, already a criminal when Peter’s monthly title begins.
